_comment: Texts of the terminal of Unzensiert (scripts\lib\AgentUi*.ps1, AgentLoop.ps1, AgentRepl.ps1), the same for every style. {0}, {1} ... are placeholders; a list of two entries under count means singular and plural. What the model reads stays in the code. Colours, glyphs and the words that belong to a style (activity verbs, done words) are in the section agent of the style file (config\styles\). Description: docs\style.md.

welcome.noRules: no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md – /init writes one
welcome.keys: Enter send · Shift+Enter new line · Esc stop · Shift+Tab rights · /help everything

modes.edits: changes files without asking, commands ask
modes.all: everything without asking – the guard decides first

permission.title: Allow?
permission.allowedAlways: allowed, also from now on in this session
permission.denied: denied – the model waits for you

turn.loop: stopped after {0}: the model was going in circles

notes.intro: Enter send · Shift+Enter new line · Esc stop · /help commands · /exit quit
notes.draft: Your text is in the history: Up arrow brings it back.
notes.serverStarting: llama-server is not running, starting it now …
notes.contextFull: The conversation no longer fits into the context.
notes.noImages: The model takes no images; they are left out.
notes.refused: {0} calls were refused; the request ends.
notes.repeating: The model repeats the same call ({0}); the request ends.
notes.noEffect: The model keeps writing what is already in the files ({0} times); the request ends.
notes.cutOff: The answer was cut off at the limit of {0} tokens.
notes.maxRounds: Stopped after {0} rounds with tools (maxToolRounds in config\unzensiert.json or --max-turns).
notes.shortened: Context: older tool results shortened by {0} characters
notes.noSummary: No summary; the conversation stays as it is.
notes.noEarlier: There is no earlier conversation in this folder.
notes.modelSwitched: Model {0} · {1} tokens of context; it loads with the next request
notes.thinkingShown: The model's thinking is now shown.
notes.thinkingHidden: The model's thinking is now hidden.

keys: stop the model, also a running command
paste an image from the clipboard
run a command yourself; the model sees it with your next message
commands: summarise the conversation (after it: what to keep)
continue an earlier conversation of this folder
show or hide the model's thinking
the model writes an AGENTS.md for the project

demo.activity: The activity line while something runs
